name: tilt

patches.old:
function copy_binary() {
  local binary_path="${1:-tilt}"
  if [[ ":$PATH:" == *":$HOME/.local/bin:"* ]]; then
      if [ ! -d "$HOME/.local/bin" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
      fi
      mv "$binary_path" "$HOME/.local/bin/tilt"
  else
      echo "Installing Tilt to /usr/local/bin which is write protected"
      echo "If you'd prefer to install Tilt without sudo permissions, add \$HOME/.local/bin to your \$PATH and rerun the installer"
      sudo mv "$binary_path" /usr/local/bin/tilt
  fi
}

smoke: "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/tilt" docker --help > /tmp/tilt-docker-help; "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/tilt" completion bash > /tmp/tilt.bash; test -s /tmp/tilt.bash; grep -q tilt /tmp/tilt.bash
notes: Converts the official upstream installer; upstream source is fetched at a fixed commit rather than vendored.
Adapts copy destination to explicit user prefix. CLI local command/completion generation tested; Docker/Kubernetes runtime is not included.

validation_scope.runtime_scope: CLI installation and local operation; no remote service, cluster or deployment is claimed.
